subject: Justin Tseng Re-election Announcement
overview: Councilor Justin Tseng announced his candidacy for re-election, outlining his legislative record and vision for Medford's future. He emphasized themes of affordability, infrastructure improvement, and community inclusivity.

items.title: Re-election Announcement
items.summary: Councilor Justin Tseng announced his bid for re-election, citing his record on school investment, housing reform, and infrastructure projects like road repairs and bus route restoration. He pledged to continue focusing on government transparency, climate change, and local economic growth.
